import uiautomation as auto
auto.SetGlobalSearchTimeout(1)
root=auto.ControlFromHandle(462320)
bv=root.PaneControl(ClassName="BrowserView",searchDepth=8)
print("BV",bv.Exists(0,0),repr(bv.Name),repr(bv.ClassName))
count=0
def walk(c,d=0):
    global count
    if d>5 or count>=400:return
    try:
        print(d,c.ControlTypeName,repr(c.Name),repr(c.AutomationId),repr(c.ClassName))
        count+=1
    except Exception:pass
    if d==5:return
    try:kids=c.GetChildren()
    except Exception:return
    for k in kids:walk(k,d+1)
if bv.Exists(0,0): walk(bv)
print("COUNT",count)
